description.value:
Emerging from ancient groves, the mandragora are a diminutive, plant-like race whose bodies resemble animated root bulbs.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Mandragoras gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, and –2 Constitution.
  • Type: Mandragoras are Humanoid Plant creatures.
  • Size: Mandragoras are Small creatures.
  • Base Speed: Mandragoras have a base speed of 20 feet.
  • Languages: Mandragoras begin play speaking Common and Mandragoran. Mandragoras with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin, and Sylvan.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Elemental Resistance: Mandragoras gain resistance 5 against earth damage.
  • Hydrated Vitality: Mandragoras gain fast healing 2 for 1 round when submerged in water.
  • Natural Armor: Mandragoras gain a +1 natural armor bonus.
  • Plant Resistance: Mandragoras gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, and polymorph effects, and are immune to sleep effects.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Camouflage: Mandragoras gain a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks in marshes, jungles, or forested terrains.

Magical Racial Traits

  • In Tune with the Earth: Mandragoras are treated as 1 level higher when casting spells with the earth descriptor.
  • Spell-Like Ability (Sp): Mandragoras can use photosynthesis once per day as a spell-like ability.

Movement Racial Traits

  • Terrain Stride: Mandragoras ignore natural difficult terrain within forests.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Shriek: Once per day, a mandragora can cause creatures within 30 feet to make a Will save or become nauseated for 1d4 rounds.
  • Weapon Familiarity: Mandragorans treat any weapon with the word 'mandragoran' as martial.

Other Racial Traits

  • Bioluminescence: A mandragora can cause part of its body to glow like a torch.
  • Sunlight Sustenance: A mandragora requires sunlight and less water than normal humanoids.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Mandragoras can see twice as far as humes in dim light.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Temperature Vulnerability: Mandragoras have a –4 penalty to Fortitude saves against environmental effects.
  • Vulnerable to Fire: Mandragoras take 150% damage from fire.
  • Weakened by Cold: Ice damage can stagger a mandragora on a failed save.
